01
Problem Space

AI Was Shipping Faster
Than Trust Could Keep Up

Every enterprise runs multiple AI agents: HR assistants, support bots, internal copilots. But once they moved beyond demos, teams hit the same wall.

Sensitive data exposed in response
Compliance violation undetected
Unexpected multi-step response path

"What should this agent never say?"

"How do we test across multiple steps?"

"How do we prove compliance before launch?"

Product & AI Engineers
"Can't debug multi-step failures."
QA Teams
"Manual testing doesn't scale."
Security & Compliance
"We need proof, not promises."
Ops & Leadership
"We see issues after customers do."
TRUST
"AI was shipping
faster than trust
could keep up."

02
Design Challenge + Solution

How Do You Test
Something That Thinks?

Traditional QA tools were built for deterministic software. AI agents are probabilistic, multi-turn, and context-aware.

Traditional QA
Deterministic only
No multi-turn testing
No trajectory analysis
TestBench
Real agent behavior
Repeatable test cases
Outcome + reasoning eval

TestBench: A Reliability Layer for AI Agents

An internal platform that lets teams register, test, evaluate, and monitor AI agents end-to-end.

Mental Model

The gap we were filling.

Traditional QA tools test deterministic systems. TestBench was built for something fundamentally different.

Old approach
Input → deterministic output
Pass / fail only
Single-turn only
No reasoning trace
TestBench approach
Real agent behaviorProbabilistic, context-sensitive, multi-model
Repeatable test casesGround truth datasets, versioned evaluation runs
Multi-turn trajectoriesTests the full conversation path, not just last reply
Outcome + reasoningJudge model evaluates quality, not just correctness

89%
avg reliability score on first successful enterprise demo run

03
Design · Test Creation

Defining Correct Before Measuring Good

Non-deterministic responses mean every interaction is different. Three creation modes let teams capture expected behavior as structured test cases.

Chat Based
Test Ground

Hello, I need help with my account

How can I assist you today?

🤖
1 turn captured

Chat with your agent and convert real conversations into test cases

Manual
Structured
Prompt

What is your refund policy for digital products?

Expected Output

We offer 30-day refunds on all digital purchases...

Write structured test cases with specific prompts and expected outputs

AI Generated
Auto
Objective

Test for compliance in HR queries

Generating 12 scenarios...
✓ Parental leave policy
✓ Benefits eligibility
⋯ PII handling edge cases

Generate test scenarios automatically based on your evaluation objectives

What We Shipped

From zero to
enterprise interest.

Evaluation Canvas
A spatial canvas where teams configure agents, models, datasets and metrics, seeing all dependencies before running.
Results + Insights
Per-metric scores, trajectory replays, and compliance filters. Engineers can see exactly which step failed and why.
Continuous Monitoring
Score history over time. Teams see regressions before users do. Clickable timeline with run-level drill-down.

07
Outcome + Reflection
Reflections

Three things
that didn't leave.

1
The hardest problem was the model of initiation. Where an evaluation starts shapes everything it can measure.
2
Making implicit dependencies visually explicit on a canvas was the design move that earned the most trust from engineers.
3
This wasn't evaluation. It was accountability infrastructure, the first time teams could point to a number and say: we checked.

From Demo to Real Enterprise Interest

Helped the client articulate agent reliability as a tangible business problem for enterprise clients

Enabled meaningful client demos with real, runnable workflows, not just wireframes

Contributed to securing enterprise interest and early partnerships
